subject: 3D Data Dinner - Palo Alto - 30th July
text:
Hi [NAME],

Thought of you as we're heading to South Bay to celebrate our 3D/ LiDAR
support launch. We're hosting a small dinner at Meyhouse, Palo Alto on 30th
of July for our robotics and Physical AI friends and I'd love for you to
join.

We'll kick things off at 6:30pm with a fireside chat exploring the
challenges and opportunities in building/scaling multimodaI models. From
there, the conversation will continue over dinner with technical execs &
engineering leaders from Mytra, Nimble, Archetype AI, etc.

In case Encord is new to you - we work with over 200 AI teams to improve
training data quality at scale. Our platform is designed to accelerate data
curation & human feedback projects for robot perception to be 6x more
efficient.

It would be great to have you join. Can I count you in?

subject: Video-native data development for home security
text:
Hi [NAME],

I came across your recent product updates for bird species identification -
very wholesome spin on home security cameras! We work on projects with
Rhombus Systems, Eagle Eye Networks and Wyze Labs on similar detection and
classification models - naturally your work at InstaVision has been on my
radar!

For context -  we help improve efficiency for computer vision data
development, where they can curate and annotate large-scale datasets and
perform tasks e.g. object tracking, segmentation and event captioning in a
video-native interface.

Would you be open to exchange perspectives? I'm quite flexible between
Tuesdays and Thursdays next week if you're open to a chat.

subject: Encord Reconnect
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on your launch of DepalOne! I imagine with the automation
capabilities expanding, you're looking to fine-tune your models with data
from customer deployments? i understand you have some familiarity with
Encord so I thought it might be worth reconnecting.

Quick recap - we help palletising robotics teams like Pickle Robot
accelerate their human-in-the-loop processes, e.g. easily identify edge
cases for model fine-tuning, as well bringing more control and visibility
for workflow orchestration.

Let me know if you're open to a catch up? happy to share some product
updates from our end. Fairly flexible Tuesday to Thursday next week if you
have a preferred time.
